about.allowlist.rule.src: Media selection rule: in each country, brands are ranked by online weekly reach in the Reuters Institute Digital News Report 2026; those with a net trust (trust minus distrust) of at least +5 points are kept and the top ten are taken (fewer where fewer brands qualify); on equal reach, higher net trust wins. Ukraine is not covered by the report, so the Institute of Mass Information's High Quality List (first half of 2026) is the credibility filter there; sites with a reach figure in the Internews Ukraine 2025 survey come first. Slovak media in Hungarian are the news sites measured in the Forum Minority Research Institute's 2021 survey of Hungarians in Slovakia, ordered by readership.
about.allowlist.rule.text: Pravidlo vašo výberos le médiengero: andre sako phuv pes o znački thoven andro poradie pal o kurkeskero online dosahos andre Reuters Institute Digital News Report 2026; ačhen odola, so len hin čisto dôvera (dôvera mínus nedôvera) najmenej +5 bodi, the pes len o prve deš (menej, te menej znački splňinen o podmienki); pal jekh dosahos rozhodinel bareder čisto dôvera. E Ukrajina naj andre správa, preto odoj sar filtros la dôverakero pes užívinel o zoznamos le kvalitne médiengero le Inštitútoskero masovo informáciengero (Institute of Mass Information, High Quality List, 1. polrokos 2026); anglal hine o weby le údajoha pal o dosahos andal o prieskumos Internews Ukraine 2025. Slovačika médiji andre ungrikani čhib hine spravodajska weby meranen andro prieskumos pal o Ungri andre Slovensko andral o berš 2021 (Forum Minority Research Institute), thode pal o genošagos.

about.method.approximate.src: The boundaries on the map are simplified and meant for orientation. The boundaries between the constituencies within a municipality are drawn around the houses that belong to them (dashed: approximate) and smoothed into plausible areas, so a few houses may lie in the area of a neighbouring constituency; the address search gives the constituency of the address itself. A few municipalities have published only the names of their constituencies (such as the lower and upper end of the village), not which houses belong to them; their constituencies are our estimate from the map, and their ballots say so.
about.method.approximate.text: O hranici pre mapa hine zjednodušimen the hine vaš orientacija. O hranici maškar o obvodi andre gav hine ľidžarde pašal o khera, so ke lende patrinen (prerušimen: pašes), the vyhladzimen andre jekhetane teritoriji, vašoda poar khera šaj te aven andro teritorijum le paštune obvodoskero; o rodiben la adresakero sikhavel o obvod la adresakero. Poar gava publikinde ča o nava pengere obvodengere (sar o tele the o upre agor le gaveskero), na save khera ke lende patrinen; lengere obvodi hine amaro odhados pal e mapa the pašal o kandidáti oda hino phendo.

about.method.candidates.src: The MV SR candidate lists carry no municipality codes, so municipalities are matched by name within their okres (district). Candidacies of one person in several contests are merged by municipality, name and age.
about.method.candidates.text: O zoznamy le kandidatengere andal o MV SR na džanen kody le obcengere, vašoda o gava phandas pal o nav andro peskero okresis. O kandidatury jekhe manušeskere andre buter voľbi thovas jekhetane pal o gav, o nav the o berša.

about.method.incumbents.src: Who holds an office now was rebuilt from the final results of the 2022 elections and of every municipal by-election since (Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic) and matched to the candidates by municipality or region, name and age. Substitutes who took up a vacated seat and departures without a by-election are missing, and a candidate whose surname changed is not matched, so the chair mark (“holds this office now”) may be incomplete. How each office holder won the seat comes from the same final results, counted in the unit where the seat was won: the municipality for a mayor, the region for a regional president, the council constituency of that election (or the whole municipality if it had one) for a councillor. The share for a mayor or president is of the valid ballots; for a council, where each voter could vote for several candidates, it is of the voters with a valid ballot, so the shares of one constituency add up to more than 100 %. The share of all registered voters and the turnout (voters who took part, of those registered) are given too.
about.method.incumbents.text: Ko hino akana andre funkcija, kerďam andal o definitivna výsledki le voľbendar andal o berš 2022 the savore neve voľbi andro organi le obcendar odvtedy (Štatistikakero urados SR) the diňam ke kandidati pal e obec abo kraj, o nav the o berša. Chiben o náhradníki, save ačhile pro uvoľnimo mandátos, the o odchodi andal e funkcija bijal neve voľbi, the kandidátos, savo pes paruďa peskero priezviskos, na phandel pes; vašoda e značka la skamindakeri („akana ľikerel kadi funkcija“) našťi te avel pherdi. Sar sako dochudľa e funkcija, phenas andal o jekh definitivna výsledki, pal o teritorijum, kaj sas vaľimen: pal e obec pašal o starostas, pal o kraj pašal o predsedas, pal ola časoskero volebno obvodos (abo calo obec, te sas la jekh obvodos) pašal o poslancos. O podielos pašal o starostas the o predsedas hino andal o platna hlasovacia lístki; pašal o zastupiteľstvo, kaj sako voličis šaj vaľinelas buter kandidáten, hino andal o gin le voličendar le platna hlasovacia lístkoha, vašoda o podieli andro jekh obvodos den jekhetane buter sar 100 %. Phenas the o podielos andal o savore zapisimen voliči the e účasť (o podielos le voličendar, save avle, andal o zapisimen).

about.method.map.src: The map is drawn directly from the ZBGIS municipal boundaries at several levels of detail, without a base map from other servers. The regional council constituencies and the city council constituencies of Bratislava and Košice consist of whole municipalities and city districts, as set by the decisions of the regions and cities. The countries around Slovakia are drawn coarser, from Natural Earth, for orientation only.
about.method.map.text: O mapa hin kerdi priamones andal o hraňici le gavengere ZBGIS andre buter urovňi detailengere, bijo podkladovo mapa andal aver servery. O volebna obvodi vaš zastupiteľstvo samosprávno krajoskero the vaš mestsko zastupiteľstvo Bratislava the Košice hine kerde andal cela gava the mestska časťi, sar phende o rozhodnuťa le krajengere the le forengere. O phuva pašal o Slovensko hine kerde hrubeder, andal Natural Earth, ča vaš orientacija.

about.method.obvody.src: Municipalities with one council constituency have it assigned directly. Municipalities and city districts with several constituencies define them in their own resolutions, by streets, house numbers or parts of the municipality. An AI agent transcribed these resolutions from the municipalities' websites into rules, which were checked to put every address of the municipality into exactly one constituency; the resolutions are linked below. Where a resolution has not been processed yet, all constituencies are shown. The number of seats comes from these resolutions; a council with one constituency whose 2026 number is not known yet shows the number elected in 2022 (Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic), labelled as such.
about.method.obvody.text: Gava jekhe obvodoha andro zastupiteľstvo les len priamo priradzimen. Gava the forošiske kotora buter obvodenca len thoven andre peskere uznesenia, pal o ulici, numeri le kherengere abo kotora le gavestere. AI agentos prepisinďa kala uznesenia andal o webi le gavengere andre pravidla, save sas skontrolimen, hoj sako adresa le gavestere te džal ča andro jekh obvod; o uznesenia hine phandle tele. Kaj o uznesenie mek naj spracimen, sikhaven pes savore obvodi. O gindo mandátura avel andal kala uznesenia; ke zastupiteľstvo jekhe obvodoha, savoro gindo pro berš 2026 mék na prindžarďol, sikhavas o gindo, so sas kidlo andro berš 2022 (Štatistikakero úrados la Slovačiko republikakero), avka sikhado.

about.method.research.src: Candidate research: for each candidate, AI agents search the sites on the list below, separately for each research language (sources in Slovak, in Hungarian and so on), decide which pages are about the candidate rather than someone with the same name, and report each relevant fact as a finding: a one-sentence claim, a verbatim quote and the page it comes from, sorted as career or controversy. Every research result first says what was searched (which sites, and when) and only then what was found; nothing found there is no proof that nothing exists. A candidate not researched yet is marked as such: no research has been done on them.
about.method.research.text: Prieskumos pal o kandidáti: pal sako kandidátos o agenta la umelo inteligencijakere roden pro weby andal o zoznamos tele, korkoro pal sako čhib (zdroja andre slovačiko, andre ungrikano the avka dureder), rozhodinen, save stránki hine čačes pal o kandidátos the na pal vareko avro le jekhe lavenca, the sako važno fakta den sar zisťišagos: jekh vetakeri phenďi, doslovno citátos the e stránka, khatar avel, zaradzimen sar kariéra abo kontroverzija. Pašal sako výsledkos le rodibnaskero angluňes phenas, so rodľam (save weby the kana), the ča paloda, so arakhľam; te odoj ňič na arakhľam, oda nane dôkazis, hoj ňič na hin. Kandidátos, savo mek na sas preskúmimen, hino avka the označimen: pal leste mek na sas rodiben.

about.method.research_check.src: Every page cited is downloaded and kept, and a finding is accepted only if its quote appears word for word in the kept copy and the page names the candidate; the copy is linked next to the original. The claims are written by artificial intelligence and no one checks them one by one; a quote in a language other than that of the interface comes with a machine translation that no one has checked. The research covers only the sites on the list and may miss things: finding nothing does not mean there is nothing.
about.method.research_check.text: Sako citimen stránka pes sťahinel the uchovinel, the o zisťišagos pes prijminel ča te lakero citátos hino lav pal lav andre uložimen kópija the e stránka menuinel le kandidátos; e kópija hiňi odkazimen paš o originálos. O phenďa pisinel e umelo inteligencija the ňiko len na kontrolinel jekh pal jekh; citátos andre aver čhib sar hiňi e čhib le rozhraniskeri, hin les strojovo preklados, so ňiko na skontrolinďa. O prieskumos chudel ča o weby andal o zoznamos the šaj vareso na dikhel: te na arakhľam ňič, na znameninel, hoj ňič nane.

app.description.src: Map of the constituencies and candidates of the Slovak municipal and regional elections of 24 October 2026.
app.description.text: Mapa le volebne obvodengeri the le kandidatengeri pre slovakika komunalna the regionalna voľbi 24. oktobris 2026.

ballots.intro.src: Voters with permanent residence here receive these ballots:
ballots.intro.text: O voliča, so adaj bešen trvalones, chuden kala hlasovacna lila:

card.disclaimer.src: The data come from the candidate lists published by MV SR (Ministry of the Interior). Withdrawals are not recorded in them.
card.disclaimer.text: O dati aven andal o zoznamy le kandidatengere, so publikinďa o MV SR (Ministerstvo vnútra). O odstupy andre lende na hine zapisimen.

card.merged.src: Candidacies are matched by municipality, name and age; a match is no proof that they are the same person.
card.merged.text: O kandidatury phandas pal o gav, o nav the o berša; kaj pes thoden jekhetane, oda na sikavel, hoj hin oda jekh manuš.

card.office_result.text: {unit}: {votes} hlasi, oda hin {share} {base} the {all} andal o savore zapisimen voliči; účasť {turnout}.

card.result_voters.text: andal o voliči le platna hlasovacia lístkoha (sako šaj vaľinelas buter kandidáten)

contest.holder_not_standing.src: In office now: {name}, not standing for it again.
contest.holder_not_standing.text: Akana andre funkcija: {name} – pre kadi funkcija pale na kandidinel.

contest.no_candidates.text: Ňiko na hin registrimen sar kandidatos.

contest.seats_2022.src: {n} seats in 2022 (2026 number not yet known)
contest.seats_2022.text: {n} mandátura andro berš 2022 (o gindo pro berš 2026 mék na prindžarďol)

council.approximate.src: The boundaries between this municipality's constituencies are approximate on the map, so near a boundary the constituency of the point you clicked may be wrong. Search for your address to be sure.
council.approximate.text: O hranici maškar o volebna obvodi kale gaveskere hine pre mapa ča pašes, vašoda paš e hranica o obvodos le thaneskero, pre savo klikinďan, našťi te avel čačo. Te džanen pre isto, roden tumari adresa.

council.choose.src: {name} elects its council in several constituencies ({n}), so all of them are listed below. Search for your address, or click your house on the map, to see only yours.
council.choose.text: {name} kidel peskero zastupiteľstvo andro buter voľbengere obvodi ({n}), vašoda hine tele sa sikhade. Roden tumari adresa abo klikinen pre tumaro kher pre mapa, te dikhen ča tumaro obvod.

council.estimated.src: {name} has not published which houses belong to which of its constituencies, only their names or seats. The constituencies here are our estimate from the map (for example the lower and upper end of the village) and may be wrong; the municipality's announcement names yours.
council.estimated.text: O gav {name} na publikinďa, save khera patrinen ke savo leskero volebno obvodos, ča lengere nava abo o gin le poslancengero. O obvodi adaj hine vašoda ča amaro odhados pal e mapa (sar o tele the o upre agor le gaveskero) the našťi te aven čačes; tiro obvodos phenel o oznamos le gaveskero.

council.none.src: There is no council election in this municipality.
council.none.text: Andre kada gav na hin voľbi andro zastupiteľstvo.

council.pending.src: {name} elects its council in several constituencies ({n}). Which addresses belong to which constituency is not available here yet, so all of them are listed below. The municipality's announcement names yours.
council.pending.text: {name} volinel peskero zastupiteľstvo andre buter volebna obvodi ({n}). Save adresy preperen ke savo obvodos, adaj mek na hin, vašoda hine dolen savore. Tiro obvodos phenel o oznamos le gaveskero.

disclaimer.ai.src: Parts written by artificial intelligence (the candidate research) are clearly marked and always link to their original source.
disclaimer.ai.text: O kotera, so pisinďa umelno inteligencija (prieskumos pal o kandidáti), hin jasnones označimen the furt odkazinen pre peskero originálno zdroj.

disclaimer.errors.src: It may contain errors. The official candidate lists and the announcements of the municipalities and regions are authoritative.
disclaimer.errors.text: Šaj andre te el chibi. Platinen o oficialna zoznamy le kandidatengere the o oznamy le obcengere the le krajengere.

disclaimer.exhaustive.src: It is not exhaustive: information on candidates may leave out important things.
disclaimer.exhaustive.text: Na hin andre savoro: o informaciji pal o kandidatura šaj na phenen vari so važno.

disclaimer.indicative.src: {site} is an indicative aid to decision-making, not a list of facts.
disclaimer.indicative.text: {site} hin orientačno pomoc vaš te rozhodines, na zoznamos faktengero.

disclaimer.short.src: An indicative aid to decision-making: it may contain errors and is not exhaustive. The officially published data are authoritative.
disclaimer.short.text: Orientačno pomoc vaš te rozhodines: šaj andre te el chibi the na hin andre savoro. Platinen o oficialna publikovana dati.

disclaimer.translation.src: The interface in languages other than Slovak and English, and the candidates' occupations in every language but Slovak, are machine translations by artificial intelligence that no one has checked. The candidate card also gives the occupation in the original Slovak.
disclaimer.translation.text: O rozhrańje andre čhiba avri slovakiko the anglicko, the o zamestnaňa le kandidatengere andre savore čhiba avri slovakiko, hine strojova preklady la umela inteligencijatar, so ňiko na skontrolinďa. Pre karta le kandidatoskeri hin o zamestnaňe the andre originalno slovakiko čhib.

error.load.src: The data could not be loaded. Please try again.
error.load.text: O dati na šaj pes ladinde. Skušin mek jekhvar.

filter.mode_hide.text: Kala hine garude. Klikinen, te sikhaven ča kalen.

filter.mode_only.text: Sikhaďon ča kala. Klikinen, te len garuven.

filter.party_drop.text: {name}. Klikinen te iľaren e partija andal o filtros.

help.how.src: Click a place on the map or search for an address, a municipality or a candidate. You will see every contest voted on there, with the candidates in ballot order.
help.how.text: Klikin pre than pre mapa abo rode adresa, gav abo kandidatos. Dikheha savore voľbi, so odoj džan, the kandidatura andre jengero poradie pre hlasovacno lil.

layers.auto.src: Those switched on appear by zoom: the regional ones on the whole map, those of Bratislava and Košice as you zoom in on the cities, those of municipal councils as you zoom in on a municipality.
layers.auto.text: O zapimen obvodi pes sikaven pal o bareariben: o krajoskere upre caľi mapa, la Bratislavakere the la Košicakere, kana bareares kala foria, o obvodi le obecne zastupiteľstvoskere, kana bareares jekh gav.

layers.oz_approximate.text: Pašes hranica le obvodoskeri, ľidžardi maškar o adresi

layers.oz_pending.text: Buter volebna obvodi; lengere hraňici mek na džanas
